statement: Users setting bills to autopay struggle to monitor when funds will actually be debited, making cash flow tracking difficult and increasing overdraft risks.
normalized_problem: Unpredictable cash flow timing caused by automated payment withdrawals
desired_outcome: Predict exactly when auto-debits will hit bank accounts to ensure sufficient funds are available.
current_solutions: Manual calendar notes for autopay dates
attempts: Setting up separate email accounts just for bill statements
Automating bill payments through bank portals
solution_complaints: Autopay hides payment timing, making it hard to know how much cash remains available in checking accounts
